rows.title: Add Invoke beside POST /tasks and POST /agent/run. The body has no principal and the profile is a name only.
rows.decision: Add Invoke beside POST /tasks and POST /agent/run. The body has no principal and the profile is a name only.

rows.title: Same key and same canonical digest returns the original definition digest and target SHA. A reload or a moved ref does not rewrite the receipt.
rows.decision: Same key and same canonical digest returns the original definition digest and target SHA. A reload or a moved ref does not rewrite the receipt.

rows.title: Same key and a different canonical digest returns 409 invocation_conflict and writes nothing.
rows.decision: Same key and a different canonical digest returns 409 invocation_conflict and writes nothing.

rows.title: Intent is part of the canonical body. new and wake on one occurrence key conflict.
rows.decision: Intent is part of the canonical body. new and wake on one occurrence key conflict.

rows.title: Human invoke is interactive. A schedule occurrence is batch.
rows.decision: Human invoke is interactive. A schedule occurrence is batch.

rows.title: A thread ref correlates replies. It is not the occurrence identity.
rows.decision: A thread ref correlates replies. It is not the occurrence identity.

rows.title: Two deliberate reviews of one pull request are two invocations.
rows.decision: Two deliberate reviews of one pull request are two invocations.

rows.title: Resolve the pull request head and base, or the ref, once. Checkout uses the pinned SHA, not the SHA written in the prompt.
rows.decision: Resolve the pull request head and base, or the ref, once. Checkout uses the pinned SHA, not the SHA written in the prompt.

rows.title: A definition that does not require a repository mints no forge token.
rows.decision: A definition that does not require a repository mints no forge token.

rows.title: The principal comes from the authenticated context. A rejected principal writes nothing.
rows.decision: The principal comes from the authenticated context. A rejected principal writes nothing.

rows.title: A profile selects reviewed defaults. Injected budget, code, credentials, or grants are profile_rejected and write nothing.
rows.decision: A profile selects reviewed defaults. Injected budget, code, credentials, or grants are profile_rejected and write nothing.

rows.title: A repository outside the allowlist is repository_rejected and writes nothing.
rows.decision: A repository outside the allowlist is repository_rejected and writes nothing.

rows.title: execute_target is a grant. Requesting it without the grant is grant_rejected and writes nothing.
rows.decision: execute_target is a grant. Requesting it without the grant is grant_rejected and writes nothing.

rows.title: The occurrence key is schedule id plus the due slot. Delivery time is not part of the key.
rows.decision: The occurrence key is schedule id plus the due slot. Delivery time is not part of the key.

rows.title: Redelivery of the same due slot returns the original receipt and does not start another run.
rows.decision: Redelivery of the same due slot returns the original receipt and does not start another run.

rows.title: Forbid overlap records skipped_overlap. It does not continue the busy item and it is not a completed scan.
rows.decision: Forbid overlap records skipped_overlap. It does not continue the busy item and it is not a completed scan.

rows.title: Two nonoverlapping due slots create two work items.
rows.decision: Two nonoverlapping due slots create two work items.

rows.title: Legacy schedule and coding-thread continuation stays the default until occurrenceMode is fresh.
rows.decision: Legacy schedule and coding-thread continuation stays the default until occurrenceMode is fresh.

rows.title: The due slot and receipt live in Postgres. Leader change and late delivery do not create a second receipt. A crash before commit inserts at most once.
rows.decision: The due slot and receipt live in Postgres. Leader change and late delivery do not create a second receipt. A crash before commit inserts at most once.

rows.title: checkRequires accepts pullRequest and report. findingsCount 0 with coverage present is success.
rows.decision: checkRequires accepts pullRequest and report. findingsCount 0 with coverage present is success.

rows.title: The input pull request never satisfies requires pullRequest.
rows.decision: The input pull request never satisfies requires pullRequest.

rows.title: Opt-in requires pullRequest still fails closed with no_work_product when no output pull request was recorded.
rows.decision: Opt-in requires pullRequest still fails closed with no_work_product when no output pull request was recorded.

rows.title: Omitted or empty requires does not demand a pull request or a report.
rows.decision: Omitted or empty requires does not demand a pull request or a report.

rows.title: requires report ships only in the same change as durable storage and a real terminal validator.
rows.decision: requires report ships only in the same change as durable storage and a real terminal validator.

rows.title: requires findings and requires artifacts are not values.
rows.decision: requires findings and requires artifacts are not values.

rows.title: Missing report when report is required fails with report_missing. It does not reuse no_work_product.
rows.decision: Missing report when report is required fails with report_missing. It does not reuse no_work_product.

rows.title: An unauthorized result read is 403 with an empty body.
rows.decision: An unauthorized result read is 403 with an empty body.

rows.title: Publication rejects absolute paths, backslashes, and .. segments.
rows.decision: Publication rejects absolute paths, backslashes, and .. segments.

rows.title: A lexically safe path that is a symlink is result_symlink_rejected.
rows.decision: A lexically safe path that is a symlink is result_symlink_rejected.

rows.title: Report bodies are at most 1 MiB and artifact files at most 16 MiB.
rows.decision: Report bodies are at most 1 MiB and artifact files at most 16 MiB.

rows.title: A secret scan hit is not published. Fixtures use the synthetic canary label only.
rows.decision: A secret scan hit is not published. Fixtures use the synthetic canary label only.

rows.title: Native mode freezes one synthetic root, an acyclic connected depth-2 tree, direct-manager delegation, and no ancestor shortcut. It is not an Atum roster.
rows.decision: Native mode freezes one synthetic root, an acyclic connected depth-2 tree, direct-manager delegation, and no ancestor shortcut. It is not an Atum roster.

rows.title: Legacy factories may omit reportsTo. The field is not enforced unless native hierarchy is on.
rows.decision: Legacy factories may omit reportsTo. The field is not enforced unless native hierarchy is on.

rows.title: The proof profile max depth is 2. The absolute max depth is 8. A deeper spawn is depth_exceeded.
rows.decision: The proof profile max depth is 2. The absolute max depth is 8. A deeper spawn is depth_exceeded.

rows.title: Direct-manager delegation requires the delegator to be reportsTo and listed in spawnableBy. spawnableBy stays parsed until M9-N enforces it.
rows.decision: Direct-manager delegation requires the delegator to be reportsTo and listed in spawnableBy. spawnableBy stays parsed until M9-N enforces it.

rows.title: parent_run_id remains the stage predecessor. A delegation edge is a different id.
rows.decision: parent_run_id remains the stage predecessor. A delegation edge is a different id.

rows.title: Reporting line does not grant secret or repository access.
rows.decision: Reporting line does not grant secret or repository access.

rows.title: Task, assignee, blockers, activation, and execution are distinct identities.
rows.decision: Task, assignee, blockers, activation, and execution are distinct identities.

rows.title: Only the stage owner advances the pipeline. A child with the same stage string does not.
rows.decision: Only the stage owner advances the pipeline. A child with the same stage string does not.

rows.title: One canonical event record per invocation. The inbox is a per-assignee projection, not a second store.
rows.decision: One canonical event record per invocation. The inbox is a per-assignee projection, not a second store.

rows.title: Inbox and comment bodies are at most 8192 bytes. DeliveryBodyCap is 256 KiB (256 << 10). maxBodyBytes is 1 MiB. Neither constant is 8192.
rows.decision: Inbox and comment bodies are at most 8192 bytes. DeliveryBodyCap is 256 KiB (256 << 10). maxBodyBytes is 1 MiB. Neither constant is 8192.

rows.title: Ack is explicit, idempotent, and scoped to task and principal. It runs only after durable apply.
rows.decision: Ack is explicit, idempotent, and scoped to task and principal. It runs only after durable apply.

rows.title: Read and long-poll do not acknowledge.
rows.decision: Read and long-poll do not acknowledge.

rows.title: A dropped response leaves the delivery unacked. Redelivery applies the message once.
rows.decision: A dropped response leaves the delivery unacked. Redelivery applies the message once.

rows.title: A duplicate ack does not apply the message twice.
rows.decision: A duplicate ack does not apply the message twice.

rows.title: Lock the invocation ledger row and commit the event, state, and outbox together. factory_seq and run_events.seq are not invocation order.
rows.decision: Lock the invocation ledger row and commit the event, state, and outbox together. factory_seq and run_events.seq are not invocation order.

rows.title: Per-run SSE cursors stay on run_events.seq.
rows.decision: Per-run SSE cursors stay on run_events.seq.

rows.title: A second claim loses the fence. The holder and fence stay unchanged.
rows.decision: A second claim loses the fence. The holder and fence stay unchanged.

rows.title: Inbox pages use an opaque cursor. Limit is 1 through 100 and defaults to 50.
rows.decision: Inbox pages use an opaque cursor. Limit is 1 through 100 and defaults to 50.

rows.title: Repeated wake intents for one task collapse to one durable wake record.
rows.decision: Repeated wake intents for one task collapse to one durable wake record.

rows.title: Capacity 1 still finishes the tree because a manager parks and releases its slot before the child runs.
rows.decision: Capacity 1 still finishes the tree because a manager parks and releases its slot before the child runs.

rows.title: Park is per task, records blockers, and releases worker capacity. Today's suspension is one per work item.
rows.decision: Park is per task, records blockers, and releases worker capacity. Today's suspension is one per work item.

rows.title: A running recipient is steered only when steer was negotiated. Otherwise the input stays pending.
rows.decision: A running recipient is steered only when steer was negotiated. Otherwise the input stays pending.

rows.title: Waking a completed task creates a new linked run. The prior terminal row stays immutable.
rows.decision: Waking a completed task creates a new linked run. The prior terminal row stays immutable.

rows.title: Infrastructure retry creates a new execution of the same run.
rows.decision: Infrastructure retry creates a new execution of the same run.

rows.title: Park continuation creates a new execution of the same run.
rows.decision: Park continuation creates a new execution of the same run.

rows.title: A cancelled task does not auto-resurrect.
rows.decision: A cancelled task does not auto-resurrect.

rows.title: Cancel and pause cascade over the chosen subtree and later spawn is spawn_denied.
rows.decision: Cancel and pause cascade over the chosen subtree and later spawn is spawn_denied.

rows.title: Board resume is an authorized audited transition. It does not mutate the cancelled run's terminal evidence.
rows.decision: Board resume is an authorized audited transition. It does not mutate the cancelled run's terminal evidence.

rows.title: fail_parent does not synthesize and does not spawn a replacement.
rows.decision: fail_parent does not synthesize and does not spawn a replacement.

rows.title: Join does not synthesize while a required child is live or unresolved.
rows.decision: Join does not synthesize while a required child is live or unresolved.

rows.title: Duplicate delegate delivery does not create a second child or a second reservation.
rows.decision: Duplicate delegate delivery does not create a second child or a second reservation.

rows.title: RunUsage adds CostCents for every usage event and does not dedup by call and attempt. The contract counts integer cents once per call and attempt, including a failed attempt.
rows.decision: RunUsage adds CostCents for every usage event and does not dedup by call and attempt. The contract counts integer cents once per call and attempt, including a failed attempt.

rows.title: RunUsage sums one run. The contract rolls each leaf charge once to invocation, lead, agent, and factory. Summing inclusive totals is not the rollup.
rows.decision: RunUsage sums one run. The contract rolls each leaf charge once to invocation, lead, agent, and factory. Summing inclusive totals is not the rollup.

rows.title: GAP: ancestor reservation is one transaction with scope rows locked in scope id order. RunUsage adds CostCents and does not lock scopes.

baseline.gap: No ancestor reservation exists. RunUsage adds CostCents per usage event.

rows.decision: GAP: ancestor reservation is one transaction with scope rows locked in scope id order. RunUsage adds CostCents and does not lock scopes.

rows.title: GAP: two concurrent reservations that would pass a 2500 cent ceiling cannot both commit. RunUsage adds CostCents and is not that transaction.

baseline.gap: No concurrent reservation transaction exists. RunUsage adds CostCents.

rows.decision: GAP: two concurrent reservations that would pass a 2500 cent ceiling cannot both commit. RunUsage adds CostCents and is not that transaction.

rows.title: GAP: an 80 percent crossing emits one alert per episode. A refund below the line starts a new episode. RunUsage adds CostCents and emits no alert.

baseline.gap: No 80 percent budget alert exists. RunUsage adds CostCents.

rows.decision: GAP: an 80 percent crossing emits one alert per episode. A refund below the line starts a new episode. RunUsage adds CostCents and emits no alert.

rows.title: Missing usage after the deadline admits no new spend. The overshoot bound is the outstanding reservation.
rows.decision: Missing usage after the deadline admits no new spend. The overshoot bound is the outstanding reservation.

rows.title: GAP: spent plus reserved stays at or under the ceiling, so attributed overshoot beyond the ceiling is 0. RunUsage adds reported CostCents and does not keep that account.

baseline.gap: No ceiling-overshoot account exists. RunUsage adds reported CostCents.

rows.decision: GAP: spent plus reserved stays at or under the ceiling, so attributed overshoot beyond the ceiling is 0. RunUsage adds reported CostCents and does not keep that account.

rows.title: GAP: a late charge above its reservation is quarantined, the scope pauses, and spent stays at the reservation. RunUsage adds the reported CostCents.

baseline.gap: No late-charge quarantine exists. RunUsage adds every usage event.

rows.decision: GAP: a late charge above its reservation is quarantined, the scope pauses, and spent stays at the reservation. RunUsage adds the reported CostCents.

rows.title: GAP: each engagement has its own gateway allocation at most the ceiling. RunUsage adds CostCents and is not that allocation.

baseline.gap: No per-engagement gateway allocation exists. RunUsage adds CostCents.

rows.decision: GAP: each engagement has its own gateway allocation at most the ceiling. RunUsage adds CostCents and is not that allocation.

rows.title: Refusing a spawn on a shared key does not guarantee the ceiling. In-flight calls on that key stay uncapped.
rows.decision: Refusing a spawn on a shared key does not guarantee the ceiling. In-flight calls on that key stay uncapped.

rows.title: GAP: an authorized ceiling override commits an audit row and changes the ceiling only. It spends nothing. RunUsage sums usage and does not raise a ceiling.

baseline.gap: No audited ceiling override exists. RunUsage sums usage events.

rows.decision: GAP: an authorized ceiling override commits an audit row and changes the ceiling only. It spends nothing. RunUsage sums usage and does not raise a ceiling.

rows.title: Child tool tokens are a subset of the parent. A specialist token cannot dispatch or cross invocations.
rows.decision: Child tool tokens are a subset of the parent. A specialist token cannot dispatch or cross invocations.

rows.title: Specialists do not dispatch roster agents. Leads may, under policy.
rows.decision: Specialists do not dispatch roster agents. Leads may, under policy.

rows.title: Internal workers stay in-session. Workflow stays main-loop-only. They are not roster nodes.
rows.decision: Internal workers stay in-session. Workflow stays main-loop-only. They are not roster nodes.

rows.title: Resolve allows only names on the allowlist. Other names fail closed.
rows.decision: Resolve allows only names on the allowlist. Other names fail closed.

rows.title: Every injection reads the mounted file again. subPath is not rotation. A running process does not rotate in place.
rows.decision: Every injection reads the mounted file again. subPath is not rotation. A running process does not rotate in place.

rows.title: A missing ref or an unsafe path is secret_ref_rejected.
rows.decision: A missing ref or an unsafe path is secret_ref_rejected.

rows.title: Redaction keeps both the old and the new synthetic values through rotation, including MCP output.
rows.decision: Redaction keeps both the old and the new synthetic values through rotation, including MCP output.

rows.title: Credential isolation is an adapter-level result. Child environment isolation alone is not accepted. An unproven boundary blocks live.
rows.decision: Credential isolation is an adapter-level result. Child environment isolation alone is not accepted. An unproven boundary blocks live.

rows.title: Scanner forge tokens are contents read and metadata read. The current DefaultPermissions write set is not a scanner token.
rows.decision: Scanner forge tokens are contents read and metadata read. The current DefaultPermissions write set is not a scanner token.

rows.title: An untrusted task gets no Docker socket, no foreign checkout write, and no broad secret mount.
rows.decision: An untrusted task gets no Docker socket, no foreign checkout write, and no broad secret mount.

rows.title: Native scanner mode uses task_ref. linear_issue is null and Linear is not required.
rows.decision: Native scanner mode uses task_ref. linear_issue is null and Linear is not required.

rows.title: GAP: local CLI mode stays available and does not require Linear or a Factory task ref. harness/run.go rejects an unknown harness adapter and does not implement that mode.

baseline.gap: No scanner local-CLI mode exists in this repository.

rows.decision: GAP: local CLI mode stays available and does not require Linear or a Factory task ref. harness/run.go rejects an unknown harness adapter and does not implement that mode.

rows.title: GAP: each item gets its own workspace mount and there is no shared writable ART root. This tree has no ART mounter.

baseline.gap: No per-item ART mount exists in this repository.

rows.decision: GAP: each item gets its own workspace mount and there is no shared writable ART root. This tree has no ART mounter.

rows.title: The durable result row outlives workspace cleanup.
rows.decision: The durable result row outlives workspace cleanup.

rows.title: GAP: one outbound owner, disabled unless a send is authorized. Outage queues reporting and does not block execution. followUp sets StageBuilding. internal/outbound posts work-item status cards. Neither is factory-outbound-bridge.

baseline.gap: No scanner outbound bridge exists. followUp sets StageBuilding.

rows.decision: GAP: one outbound owner, disabled unless a send is authorized. Outage queues reporting and does not block execution. followUp sets StageBuilding. internal/outbound posts work-item status cards. Neither is factory-outbound-bridge.

rows.title: GAP: a paid probe stays closed until G14, G18, and the gateway cap are proved on the actual backend. assign.go fills SidecarImage. docs/11 records the intended NetworkPolicy and host-firewall posture and does not implement the gate.

baseline.gap: No G14, G18, or paid-probe gate exists. assign.go sets SidecarImage.

rows.decision: GAP: a paid probe stays closed until G14, G18, and the gateway cap are proved on the actual backend. assign.go fills SidecarImage. docs/11 records the intended NetworkPolicy and host-firewall posture and does not implement the gate.

rows.title: GAP: the witness is valid only when bound and observed match, including secretPolicy. mintGitHubToken calls InstallationToken with DefaultPermissions and does not bind digests or secret policy.

baseline.gap: No attestation binder exists. InstallationToken mints a forge token.

rows.decision: GAP: the witness is valid only when bound and observed match, including secretPolicy. mintGitHubToken calls InstallationToken with DefaultPermissions and does not bind digests or secret policy.

rows.title: POST /tasks keeps its work-item meaning. POST /agent/run stays a bare run. Neither becomes Invoke.
rows.decision: POST /tasks keeps its work-item meaning. POST /agent/run stays a bare run. Neither becomes Invoke.
